tools.name: setup.check
tools.description: Compare the installed Feedster skill's VERSION with the server's bundled release. Check once per session using local files when available. Report local_status=missing only after confirming absence, present for an installed skill (omit installed_version for older unversioned installs), or unknown whe

tools.name: account.get
tools.description: Return the authenticated Feedster account's stable ID and username (as nickname). The ID remains unchanged across token refresh, reconnection, and username changes. No account selector is accepted.

tools.name: onboarding.status
tools.description: Check whether the connected account completed onboarding and read its current username. If incomplete, offer starter channels using onboarding.templates. This check does not change the account.

tools.name: onboarding.templates
tools.description: List the same curated starter channels and feed counts offered during web onboarding. Reading this list does not subscribe the user.

tools.name: onboarding.check_username
tools.description: Check whether a chosen Feedster username is available before completing onboarding. Usernames must be 3–50 ASCII letters, numbers, periods, underscores, or hyphens.

tools.name: onboarding.complete
tools.description: Save the user's chosen username (3–50 ASCII letters, numbers, periods, underscores, or hyphens) and copy selected starter channels with their public feeds into private channels. Use IDs from onboarding.templates and only choices authorized by the user. Preserves existing channels and feeds. Already

tools.name: articles.front_page
tools.description: Ranked articles from the authenticated user's library.

tools.name: articles.list
tools.description: Read articles in the user's library. Filter by channel or feed. Use cursor from the result for subsequent pages, or page for numbered pagination.

tools.name: articles.get
tools.description: Read an accessible article by item_id, with character offsets to page through long content.

tools.name: articles.search
tools.description: Full-text search of articles and the user's own bookmarks. Part of Feedster Pro: on the free plan it returns an upgrade message instead of results; relay it rather than retrying. A result with a bookmark object is a saved page, not an article: its feed_title is the site name, published_at is the dat

tools.name: highlights.list
tools.description: Read the connected user's private saved quotes and notes, newest first (up to 100 per page). Filter by article item_id, bookmark_slug, feed_slug, or related_to article ID. Pass a nonzero next_cursor from the result as before, retaining filters; before is a numeric highlight ID, not a date. max_chars

tools.name: highlights.create
tools.description: Save a private highlight from an accessible article or owned bookmark. Supply exactly one of item_id or bookmark_slug, and an exact quote from content you read (1–5000 characters). Optional note is at most 5000 characters; prefix/suffix (up to 200 each) anchor repeated passages. source_view defaults

tools.name: highlights.update
tools.description: Replace the note on one of the connected user's highlights. Use highlight_id from highlights.list or highlights.create. An empty note clears it. This does not edit the saved quote, source, or anchoring context. Only edit a note when requested by the user.

tools.name: highlights.delete
tools.description: Permanently delete one of the connected user's highlights and its note, leaving the article, bookmark, feeds, and other highlights intact. Use highlight_id from highlights.list or highlights.create. Only delete the highlight the user requested.

tools.name: channels.list
tools.description: List owned and subscribed channels, including ownership and visibility metadata.

tools.name: channels.get
tools.description: Get a channel from your owned or subscribed channels.

tools.name: channels.search
tools.description: Search public channels to subscribe to. Does not subscribe or change your library.

tools.name: channels.create
tools.description: Create a channel. Private by default; is_public=true publishes it for other users to discover and subscribe to. Set is_public only when the user requests public sharing.

tools.name: channels.update
tools.description: Update only supplied fields on an owned channel. Changes to public channels are visible to other users; is_public=true publishes the channel for discovery and subscription, while is_public=false removes subscriptions.

tools.name: channels.delete
tools.description: Delete an owned channel and its memberships. Shared public feeds remain; orphaned private subscriptions may be deleted. Cannot delete a subscribed channel owned by someone else.

tools.name: channels.subscribe
tools.description: Subscribe to a public channel owned by another user.

tools.name: channels.unsubscribe
tools.description: Remove your subscription to someone else's channel.

tools.name: feeds.list
tools.description: List your feeds, optionally within a channel. Includes private/unavailable flags; private source credentials are not returned.

tools.name: feeds.get
tools.description: Get a feed from your library, optionally in a channel. Does not reveal private subscription URLs.

tools.name: feeds.search
tools.description: Search the public Feedster feed catalog by title or URL. channel_id excludes feeds already in an owned channel. Results are paginated; this does not search the entire web or subscribe.

tools.name: feeds.discover
tools.description: Validate an RSS/Atom or website URL and discover available feeds without subscribing. May fetch the source website. Set is_private for credential-bearing subscription URLs.

tools.name: feeds.create
tools.description: Subscribe an owned channel to a feed URL (existing public feeds are reused). Use feeds.search or feeds.discover first when the URL is unknown. Set is_private for personal subscription URLs; never publish those URLs.

tools.name: feeds.update
tools.description: Replace the source URL of an owned private subscription. Public feed metadata is shared and cannot be edited by this tool.

tools.name: feeds.remove
tools.description: Remove a feed from one owned channel. Other channel memberships remain. The last removal of a private subscription deletes that subscription and its articles.

tools.name: feeds.delete
tools.description: Permanently delete an owned private subscription, its articles and all channel memberships. For public feeds or a single channel removal use feeds.remove.

tools.name: feeds.refresh
tools.description: Queue ingestion for your library or one accessible channel. Completion of this request does not mean new articles have finished ingesting.

tools.name: bookmarks.list
tools.description: List the connected user's private bookmarks, newest first. Returns metadata and excerpts, not saved content; use bookmarks.get to read a snapshot. limit is 1–50 (default 50). Pass a nonzero next_cursor as the numeric before argument, retaining filters. Use site from bookmarks.sites, or related_to bo

tools.name: bookmarks.sites
tools.description: List the connected user's bookmarked sites and counts. Pass a returned slug unchanged as site to bookmarks.list. This reads only the user's saved collection; it does not discover websites or fetch pages.

tools.name: bookmarks.get
tools.description: Read an owned bookmark's metadata and saved HTML snapshot using bookmark_slug from bookmarks.list or bookmarks.create. Reading does not mark it read or fetch the original URL. Link-only saves have no snapshot. max_chars bounds excerpt and content; continue with pagination.excerpt_next_offset or cont

tools.name: bookmarks.create
tools.description: Save a private bookmark for an HTTP(S) URL without embedded credentials. Only url is required; optional title, excerpt, site_name, and content must come from the actual source. content is a saved HTML reading snapshot (at most 500000 UTF-8 bytes). Without supplied content, Feedster attempts to fetch

tools.name: bookmarks.update
tools.description: Mark an owned bookmark read or unread using bookmark_slug and is_read. Changes only read state; editing its URL, title, or snapshot is unsupported. Use the slug from bookmarks.list or bookmarks.create and change state only when requested.

tools.name: bookmarks.delete
tools.description: Permanently remove an owned bookmark and its saved reading snapshot. The original website, feeds, articles, and other bookmarks remain. Use bookmark_slug from actual results and delete only the bookmark requested by the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: onboarding.templates, articles.list, articles.search, highlights.delete, feeds.list, feeds.get, feeds.search, feeds.discover, feeds.create, bookmarks.get, bookmarks.create, bookmarks.update · Private data: setup.check, account.get, onboarding.complete, highlights.list, highlights.create, channels.create, channels.delete, feeds.list, feeds.get, feeds.discover, feeds.update, feeds.remove, feeds.delete, bookmarks.list, bookmarks.create · Public sink: feeds.create, bookmarks.create · Destructive: highlights.delete, channels.delete, channels.unsubscribe, feeds.remove, feeds.delete, bookmarks.create, bookmarks.delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: onboarding.templates, articles.list, articles.search, highlights.delete, feeds.list, feeds.get, feeds.search, feeds.discover, feeds.create, bookmarks.get, bookmarks.create, bookmarks.update · Private data: setup.check, account.get, onboarding.complete, highlights.list, highlights.create, channels.create, channels.delete, feeds.list, feeds.get, feeds.discover, feeds.update, feeds.remove, feeds.delete, bookmarks.list, bookmarks.create · Public sink: feeds.create, bookmarks.create · Destructive: highlights.delete, channels.delete, channels.unsubscribe, feeds.remove, feeds.delete, bookmarks.create, bookmarks.delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
